title: ExtractedTable
description: A table extracted from a document with its rows and column headers

name.description: The name or label of the extracted table

headers.description: The column headers of the extracted table

items.description: A cell value in the table row

rows.description: The data rows of the extracted table

confidence.description: The confidence score for the table extraction (0.0 to 1.0)

page_number.description: The page number where the table was found
